voiceSummary: Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited has intimated the schedule of meetings with analysts and institutional investors under SEBI regulations. A physical group meeting is scheduled for 21st November 2026 from 11AM to 2PM IST at Taj Yelahanka, Bengaluru. Participants include Ajinkya S from Adfactors PR, Kunjal Palan from Nimida Capital, Rahul Dani and Aashil Shah from Monarch Networth Capital, CJ Shah from CJ Shah Family Office, Yash Dantewadia and Rajesh Dantewadia, Saikat Majumdar from HSBC Securities, Bhavya Sonawala from Samaasa Capital, Sumukh U from Korman Capital, and Nagesh Rajanna as an investor. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. The company requests the exchanges to take this information on record.
